criteria_change: none; preserve the existing benchmark gate
development_data: original SECOM training partition only for candidate selection; original calibration partition for calibration and decision-threshold fitting
candidate_selection: fixed candidate family comparison using three forward chronological validation folds within the original training partition; select greatest mean average precision; no legacy test or new confirmation data used
candidates: training-only univariate feature selection with regularized logistic regression, random forests, extra trees and gradient boosting
legacy_test: already exposed; diagnostic regression evidence only, not fresh acceptance
new_confirmation: user reports additional unseen data; location pending; seal until candidate and threshold freeze
threshold_selection: maximize recall subject to the unchanged false-alert budget on the original calibration partition; freeze before confirmation
guarded_acceptance: report deployed shadow guard coverage and end-to-end recall in addition to raw classifier metrics; abstentions on failures count as missed failures
promotion: reference-only; production authority remains blocked without real pilot evidence
